notes.title: 🌙 DALDZAH Demo Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Bajraj!

We're thrilled to announce that the demo for our upcoming North Caucasian adventure game, DALDZAH, is now live on Steam, and we will be participating in Steam Next Fest with it! We're very grateful for this opportunity 💛

🌙 Get the Demo Here: DALDZAH Demo

DALDZAH has been a year in the making and we can't wait for you to get a taste of what it has to offer. The demo consists of the first 3 levels: Ruins of the Death, Tower City, and Sun Fields, just waiting for you to enter!

🌙 We Need Your Feedback
As we continue to fine-tune DALDZAH for its full release, we're eager to hear your thoughts and suggestions. Your feedback will play a vital role in shaping the final version of the game, ensuring it becomes the unforgettable adventure we envision it to be.
Fill the form to leave your feedback: Google Form]DALDZAH Demo Feedback Google Form

✨ How to Play the DALDZAH Demo

 Visit our Steam store page
 Click the "Download Demo" button

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm as we embark on this incredible journey together. Share your feedback, screenshots, and stories from your adventure with us and the community!

See you on the Mountain, traveller! ❤️‍🔥
